9370.commentary: (DNa) asaññasattā'ti desan'āsīsam'etaṃ, acitt'uppādā rūpamattaka-attabhāvā'ti attho. tesaṃ evaṃ uppatti veditabbā, ekacco hi titth'āyatane pabbajitvā vāyokasiṇe parikammaṃ katvā catutthajjhānaṃ nibbattetvā jhānā vuṭṭhāya, citte dosaṃ passati, citte sati hatthacched'ādi-dukkhañ'c'eva sabbabhayāni ca honti, alaṃ iminā cittena, acittakabhāvo'va santo'ti, evaṃ citte dosaṃ passitvā aparihīnajjhāno kālaṃ katvā asaññasattesu nibbattati, cittam'assa cuticittanirodhena idh'eva nivattati, rūpakkhandhamattam'eva tattha pātubhavati. te tattha yathā nāma jiyāvegakkhitto saro yattako jiyāvego, tattakam'eva ākāse gacchati. evam'eva jhānavegakkhittā upapajjitvā yattako jhānavego, tattakam'eva kālaṃ tiṭṭhanti, jhānavege pana parihīne tattha rūpakkhandho antaradhāyati, idha pana paṭisandhisaññā uppajjati. yasmā pana tāya idha uppannasaññāya tesaṃ tattha cuti paññāyati, tasmā saññ'uppādā ca pana te devā tamhā kāyā cavantī'ti vuttaṃ.

9372.meaning2: non perception; non conception; non recognition

examples.text: n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanaṃ n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanato sañjānāti, n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanaṃ n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanato saññatvā n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanaṃ maññati, n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanasmiṃ maññati, n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanato maññati, n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanaṃ me'ti maññati, n'evasaññā-na-asaññā-āyatanaṃ abhinandati.
saññā rogo saññā gaṇḍo saññā sallaṃ, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ, asaññan'ti.
sant'āvuso, sattā asaññino appaṭisaṃvedino, seyyathā'pi devā asaññisattā. ayaṃ pañcamo satt'āvāso.

9374.commentary: (THa) n'evasaññisu asaññisuṭṭhitan'ti rūp'ārūpadhātūsu ca na kevalaṃ saññīsu eva, atha kho n'evasaññī-n'āsaññīsu asaññīsu ca upapajja ṭhitaṃ mayā'ti ānetvā yojetabbaṃ. n'evasaññiggahaṇena h'ettha n'evasaññī-n'āsaññībhavo gahito. yadi'p'ime dve bhavā rūp'ārūpadhātuggahaṇen'eva gayhanti, ye pana ito bāhirakā tattha niccasaññino bhavavimokkhasaññino ca, tesaṃ tassā saññāya micchābhāvadassan'atthaṃ visuṃ gahitā'ti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

examples.text: mānuso'pi ca bhavo'bhirādhito, saggakāyam'agamaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ, rūpadhātusu arūpadhātusu, n'evasaññisu asaññisuṭṭhitaṃ.

9375.commentary: (NIDD1) no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī'ti. asaññino vuccanti nirodhasamāpannā ye ca asaññasattā, na'pi so nirodhasamāpanno, na'pi asaññasatto.

examples.text: yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā n'evasaññin'āsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.

ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā

9377.meaning1: impercipient state of being; unconscious existence

examples.text: apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā katamehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti? soḷasa saññīvādā, aṭṭha asaññīvādā, aṭṭha n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā, satta ucchedavādā, pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā imehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti.

9379.meaning1: holding a doctrine of impercipient (post-mortem existence)
9379.meaning2: holding the doctrine of impercipient (post-mortem existence)

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddham'āghātanikā asaññīvādā uddham'āghātanaṃ asaññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti aṭṭhahi vatthūhi.

9380.grammar: masc, from na saṃyojeti, neg, caus
9380.construction: na > a + saṃ + yoje > yoge + a

examples.text: tatr'aggivessana ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, sabbaṃ me nakkhamatī'ti tesam'ayaṃ diṭṭhi asārāgāya santike, asaññogāya santike, anabhinandanāya santike, anajjhosānāya santike, anupādānāya santike'ti.

9381.meaning1: honest; sincere; not devious; not deceitful

examples.text: ye pana te kulaputtā saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā asaṭhā amāyāvino aketabino anuddhatā anunnaḷā acapalā amukharā avikiṇṇavācā… tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko, aham'anusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.

9382.construction:
na > a + saṃ + ṭhaha + ana + ika
asaṇṭhahana + ika

9383.meaning1: not fixed (in); not stuck (in); not caught (in); not attached (to)
9383.meaning2: not firm, not well established, unsettled
9383.commentary: (MNa) ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitan'ti gocarajjhatte nikantivasena asaṇṭhitaṃ. (ITIa) arūpesu asaṇṭhitā'ti arūparāgena arūpabhavesu appatiṭṭhahantā, te'pi parijānantā'ti attho.

examples.text: ye ca rūpe pariññāya, arūpesu asaṇṭhitā, nirodhe ye vimuccanti, te janā maccuhāyino.
tathā tathā, bhikkhave, bhikkhu upaparikkheyya yathā yathā upaparikkhato bahiddhā c'assa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭaṃ, ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitaṃ anupādāya na paritasseyya.

yadapi luddho lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati.

9389.grammar: prp, abl sg of na santa, neg, intrans
9389.meaning1: from nonexistence; because of the absence
9389.construction:

asanta + tā

examples.text: yassa loke sakaṃ n'atthi, asatā ca na socati, dhammesu ca na gacchati, sa ve santo'ti vuccatī'ti.
sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ, yassa n'atthi mamāyitaṃ, asatā ca na socati, sa ve loke na jīyati.

9390.meaning1: lack of clear present moment awareness; non-attentiveness

examples.text: ko c'āhāro indriyāsaṃvarassa? asat'āsampajaññan'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ. asat'āsampajaññam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sāhāraṃ vadāmi, no anāhāraṃ. ko c'āhāro asat'āsampajaññassa? ayonisomanasikāro'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ

9391.grammar: prp, masc loc sg of na santa, loc abs, neg, intrans

examples.text: nissitassa calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ n'atthi. calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti. natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti. āgatigatiyā asati cut'ūpapāto na hoti. cut'ūpapāte asati n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
so evaṃ samanupassanto asati na paritassatī'ti.

9392.grammar: fem, abstr, from na sarati, neg

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno, na sarāmī'ti asatiyā nibbeṭheti.

9395.construction: na > a + sati + na + manasi + kāra
9395.commentary: (ANa) asatiamanasikāro'ti yathā so puggalo na upaṭṭhāti, kuṭṭ'ādīhi antarito viya hoti, evaṃ tasmiṃ asatiamanasikāro āpajjitabbo.

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesaṃ vitakkānaṃ asatiamanasikāro āpajjitabbo.

9397.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of na santa, neg
9397.construction:

asanta + tī
9397.commentary: (SNa) asatī kir'āyan'ti asatī kira ayaṃ vīṇā, lāmikā'ti attho. asatī'ti lāmak'ādhivacanam'etaṃ.

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, asatī kir'āyaṃ, bho, vīṇā nāma, yath'evaṃ yaṃ kiñci vīṇā nāma ettha ca pan'āyaṃ jano ativelaṃ pamatto palaḷito'ti.
anomanāmaṃ nipuṇ'atthadassiṃ, paññādadaṃ kām'ālaye asattaṃ, taṃ passatha sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, ariye pathe kamamānaṃ mahesin'ti.
yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedagum'ābhijaññā, akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattaṃ, addhā hi so ogham'imaṃ atāri, tiṇṇo ca pāraṃ akhilo akaṅkho.
parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
